label: If an actual CONCRETE_6 individual depends for its being on a different one, that one grounds it
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, the distinct-relata restriction of STMT-ACTUAL-DEPENDENCE-IS-GROUNDING: if an actual concretum x depends for its being on an actual concretum c distinct from x, then c grounds x under the selected relation at w. It is silent on D(x,x), so a reflexive reading of DependsForBeing does not turn it into self-grounding. One direction only.
